row.title: One-year survival: Cloudflare alerts, daily D1 copy, compatibility dates
row.body: CF-ALERTS-1, D1-SNAPSHOT-1, COMPAT-DATE-1: Cloudflare alerts post to the tick's /hook/cloudflare and become CF-ALERT items that close after 24 quiet hours (deploy/cf-alerts.mjs registers the destination and policies); the tick copies its D1 into the new R2 bucket ultrastable-audit daily and reads it back (seed/worker/src/d1snapshot.js); compatibility dates older than 180 days advance on the watchdog runway pass (foundation/compatdate.py). dependency-drift and self-coder closed in doctrine/unattended.json with evidence; node-runtime stays open because workflow files are on the model-branch deny list.
